selected_endpoint.title: Original repeated-video model–brain representational alignment
selected_endpoint.source_locator: ICLR 2025 One Hundred Neural Networks and Brains Watching Videos, Sections 3.1–3.3, Equations 1–3 and original main PCA model-alignment profiles. Exact reported profile arrays remain unrecovered.
selected_endpoint.scope: Original main PCA representational-alignment endpoint on all 102 repeated test videos, ten participants, 17 original ROIs and 99 original model conditions. Reproduce source participant/layer/ROI RSA and original mean-then-layer-max profiles; evaluate a frozen candidate representation on the same observations against the strongest relevant original model per ROI, retaining the complete 17-ROI vector. This is an explicit original performance endpoint selection, not improvement of architecture-family biological significance.

target.description: Original out-of-the-box model-layer representational alignment to BOLDMoments brain ROIs on the repeated test videos. Reproduce all 99 main PCA reference-condition profiles; evaluate a frozen candidate model on identical observations against the strongest applicable original model per ROI, retaining all 17 ROIs. Biological architecture/family interpretations are separately retained.

dataset.description: Original BOLDMoments versionB MNI152 merged-hemisphere/stream derivatives and corresponding 102 repeated test videos. The exact immutable source-to-OpenNeuro derivative/stimulus/checkpoint joins remain unauthenticated; nominal metadata labels do not validate brain/video bytes.

cohort.description: All ten original human participants, 17 original ROIs and 99 main PCA model conditions. The source-reported counts and protocol labels are retained; exact derivative/ROI identities, model checkpoints and emitted-layer catalogues require authentication. Candidate layers may differ but must be complete and frozen before feedback.

split.description: Original 102 repeated test videos, each presented ten times. This original public analysis panel is not an unseen candidate test. The 1000-video training analysis is separate and does not replace the repeated test panel or become mandatory for this selected main endpoint.

inputs.description: Original video inputs, source pretrained-model representations and participant-specific ROI responses support out-of-the-box RSA. Candidate representation receives matched permitted observations and declared pretrained exposure. No fitted voxel-wise readout, brain-target reweighting or post-feedback ROI/layer subset is part of the original endpoint.

preprocessing.description: Preserve source averaging of brain repetitions, video subclip/feature aggregation, unstandardized PCA100 and the released script 102 estimator rows. Exact original checkpoint, layer, dependency and historical reduction settings remain unresolved; training-video/SRP/unreduced branches are separately retained.

metric.description: Form model and brain dissimilarities as 1 minus Pearson correlation. Layer/participant/ROI alignment is signed Spearman correlation of corresponding upper-triangle RDM entries. Do not substitute absolute correlation, a fitted encoding score or an RDM-entry-independent significance test.

aggregation.description: First average each layer RSA across all ten participants; then select the first maximum signed mean layer in source order separately for each ROI. Retain full participant/layer data and all 17 ROI scores against the complete 99-condition reference catalogue. Do not average participant-wise maxima, selected ROIs or invent a pooled scalar.

selected_endpoint.metric: Complete original 17-ROI signed subject-mean RSA followed by source layer maximum, with all 99 main reference conditions retained
selected_endpoint.comparator: Full original 99 main PCA model-condition profiles and strongest applicable original model per ROI. Exact authentic reference arrays and test noise ceilings remain unavailable; no convenient weak reference or selected ROI is sufficient.

retained_broader_reproduction.description: Original temporal versus classification-task and architecture/training/depth comparative biological interpretations remain separately named reproduction scopes. The 92-model SRP/unreduced Figure 16 controls, 51-model 1000-training-video Figure 17 analysis and auxiliary VideoMAE control remain distinct source scopes; none is silently counted as 99-model main-panel completion.
retained_broader_reproduction.old_primary: The retained comparative participant/regional RSA profiles and declared temporal-model versus classification-task and architecture/layer findings on the original ten-participant, 102 repeated-test-video panel. Preserve complete source-defined support for each named result and its necessary controls; do not infer a requirement for all 22 figures or substitute the separate training-video analysis.

source_recovery_blocks: Authenticate original versionB derivatives, repeated videos, ROI/participant identities, all 99 main source model checkpoints and complete emitted-layer catalogues.
Recover authentic original participant/layer/ROI RSA arrays, mean-then-layer-max profiles and test noise ceilings; no exact numerical reference vector is available.
Resolve historical feature/subclip aggregation, PCA100 without standardization, 102-row estimator and dependency settings from result-producing source evidence.

The existing original-panel comparator requires a larger 335-condition record with separate controls/training scopes. A selected-main-panel evaluator must preserve every 99-model/17-ROI reference, required test companions and exact layer selection without manufacturing absent 335-condition inputs or dropping genuine required main companions.
Freeze candidate representations and complete layer catalog, permitted public-panel feedback and pretrained exposure before final evaluation; do not call the public panel unseen.
Qualify authentic feature/RDM/RSA derivation and independent source-reference replay; predeclare meaningful effect, selection-aware participant/stimulus inference and across-ROI superiority rule.

Paired data/weights/common preprocessing assistance, official alignment-code manifest and resource allowances remain uninstantiated. No fitted brain readout or target reweighting is allowed as the same task.

The current improvement/v1 comparator admits a single numeric score. This selected original endpoint is a full profile without a source-defined scalar aggregate; no mean, win-count or other scalar is invented. A source-grounded full-panel comparison/admission route is required before improvement activation.
integration_requirement: Integrator must add an authenticated versioned selector for this explicit endpoint; this candidate does not bypass old deterministic binding or revise predecessor files. No admission or scientific result is asserted.
